title: Remove duplicates
statementMd: Return a new list with duplicates removed, **keeping the first occurrence** of each item in its original order.
hints: Only append an item the first time you see it.
solutionMd:
```python
def dedupe(items):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result
```

`list(set(items))` loses order; tracking a `seen` set keeps it. (`list(dict.fromkeys(items))` is a neat one-liner.)
